Technical requirements

Observable checks for planning, revising, and rehearsing a timed group presentation.

Open a fresh demo Open the workspace

Scope

Plans are stored in one browser. Backups can transfer projects; simultaneous editing across devices is outside the current scope. People mark prerequisites. Ready means a nonempty plan fits the time limit and all marked prerequisites appear before their dependents.

Requirements for mentor review

Two required implementation demonstrations and five product requirements. Approval and any revisions are recorded after mentor review.
